meta.title: Android Reverse Engineering Methodology, Static Analysis, Dynamic Analysis & Professional Workflow
meta.subtitle: Beginner → Expert Investigation & Binary Analysis Roadmap
meta.completionMessage: Congratulations! You have completed the masterclass roadmap for Android Reverse Engineering Methodology, Static/Dynamic Analysis, Architectural Recovery, Call Graph Construction, Security Review, and Professional Documentation!

stages.title: Stage 1 — Reverse Engineering Mindset
stages.subtitle: Structured Investigation Philosophy & Inquiry Checklist

details.title: Investigation Philosophy
items: Treating reverse engineering as a structured systematic investigation
Avoiding premature randomly oriented Smali/Decompiler inspection
Building a holistic mental model before diving into low-level bytecode

details.title: Core Analytical Inquiry Checklist
items: What domain problem does this application solve?
How is the high-level system architected?
Which frameworks, libraries, and native stacks are used?
Where is the handwritten business logic located vs compiler-generated infrastructure?
Which internal and external components communicate together?
What data enters the application (inputs, intents, network, IPC)?
What data leaves the application (sinks, APIs, telemetry, persistence)?

stages.title: Stage 2 — APK Triage
stages.subtitle: Package Metadata, Signatures, Fingerprints & Surface Extraction

details.title: Metadata & Boundary Extraction
items: Package name & Application label identification
Version code & Version name tracking
Target SDK, Minimum SDK, & Compile SDK evaluation
Signing certificate extraction & X.509 fingerprinting (v1, v2, v3, v4 schemes)
Supported ABIs inventory (`arm64-v8a`, `armeabi-v7a`, `x86_64`)
Declared Permissions & Hardware/Software Features
Declared Components: Activities, Services, BroadcastReceivers, ContentProviders
Intent Filters, Deep Links, & Android App Links configurations
Shared native libraries (`.so`) inventory & extraction rules
Asset size, DEX file count, & resource table (`resources.arsc`) metrics
Manifest metadata, Build fingerprints, & Android Gradle Plugin (AGP) indicators

stages.title: Stage 3 — Package Structure Analysis
stages.subtitle: Namespace Layout, Module Isolation & Architectural Partitioning

details.title: Package Topology Inspection
items: Application module partitioning & feature package structures
Utility & common helper package boundaries
Third-party library namespaces identification
Compiler-generated and annotation-processor package separation
Dependency injection packages (`di/`, `hilt_aggregated_deps/`)
Networking, Persistence, Presentation, & Domain package hierarchies
Native shared library (`lib/`) and raw asset (`assets/`) partitioning

stages.title: Stage 4 — Framework Identification
stages.subtitle: Tech Stack Fingerprinting & Library Profiling

details.title: Library & Framework Profiling Catalog
items: UI Frameworks: Jetpack Compose, XML Views, Material Design
Dependency Injection: Hilt, Dagger, Koin, Service Locator
Architecture & Async: ViewModels, LiveData, Kotlin Coroutines, Flow, RxJava
Persistence & Background: Room, DataStore, SharedPreferences, WorkManager, Paging 3
Navigation & Binding: Navigation Component, ViewBinding, DataBinding
Networking & Serialization: Retrofit, OkHttp, Moshi, Gson, kotlinx.serialization, Ktor
Media & Hardware: CameraX, ExoPlayer / Media3, WebViews, Biometric, Location
Building a comprehensive technology profile prior to business logic analysis

stages.title: Stage 5 — Build Fingerprinting
stages.subtitle: Compiler Versions, AGP Patterns & Release Characteristics

details.title: Build System Fingerprinting
items: Programming language determination (Java vs Kotlin vs C/C++ Native)
Java / Kotlin compiler version indicators (`@Metadata` inspection)
Jetpack Compose compiler plugin artifacts and IR transformations
Android Gradle Plugin (AGP) signature patterns in DEX
Inferred dependency versions via pom properties/metadata
Debug vs Release build characteristics (Debuggable flags, stripping, R8/ProGuard rules)

stages.title: Stage 6 — Architecture Reconstruction
stages.subtitle: Pattern Recovery, Layer Boundaries & Data Flows

details.title: Architectural Pattern Identification
items: Pattern Classification: MVC, MVP, MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture
Layer Isolation: Presentation, Domain, Data, Platform Infrastructure
Feature modularization topology
Repository Pattern & Use Case / Interactor boundaries
Dependency graph wiring and component scopes
Mapping UI layer to Data layer data flow pipelines

stages.title: Stage 7 — Manifest Analysis
stages.subtitle: Attack Surface Mapping, Component Exporting & Permissions

details.title: Attack Surface Audit
items: Main / Launch Activity identification
Process assignment (`android:process`) & shared UIDs
Requested & custom permission declarations
Exported components (`android:exported="true"`) security audit
Unprotected Services, BroadcastReceivers, and ContentProviders
Backup configuration (`android:allowBackup`, custom BackupAgent)
Network Security Configuration (`networkSecurityConfig`) evaluation
Custom Intent Filters, Scheme Handlers, & App Links validation

stages.title: Stage 8 — Resource Analysis
stages.subtitle: Layout Mapping, Asset Extraction & Identifier Resolution

details.title: Resource Inspection & Mapping
items: Compiled Binary XML layout inspection (`res/layout/`)
Resource table (`resources.arsc`) entry mapping
Theme, Style, & Color State List analysis
Navigation graph XML (`res/navigation/`) inspection
Raw assets (`assets/`) & embedded file payloads extraction
Mapping R.java / Hexadecimal Resource IDs (0x7f...) to source code usage

stages.title: Stage 9 — DEX Analysis
stages.subtitle: MultiDEX Partitioning, String Pools & Class Inventories

details.title: DEX Structure Inspection
items: MultiDEX distribution (`classes.dex`, `classes2.dex`, `classesN.dex`)
Package and Class hierarchy indexing
Method and Field reference count evaluation (65k limit checks)
Interfaces and Inheritance hierarchies mapping
Kotlin `@Metadata` annotation payload parsing
Generated class infrastructure vs handwritten application DEX code

stages.title: Stage 10 — Call Graph Construction
stages.subtitle: Cross-References, Callback Chains & Execution Traversal

details.title: Call Graph Methodologies
items: Identifying system and lifecycle entry points
Constructing Forward Call Trees (Callees) & Reverse Call Trees (Callers)
Mapping Method Cross-References (XREFs)
Virtual dispatch and interface implementation edge resolution
Tracing asynchronous callback chains (Coroutines, Flow, RxJava, Listeners)
Tracing Binder IPC boundaries and JNI transitions
Building both high-level component diagrams and low-level method execution graphs

stages.title: Stage 11 — Control Flow Analysis
stages.subtitle: Basic Blocks, Conditional Branches & Switch Lowering

details.title: Control Structure Recovery
items: Partitioning bytecode into Basic Blocks
Evaluating conditional branches (`if-eqz`, `if-ne`, `CMP`)
Loop recovery (for, while, do-while structures)
Switch lowering analysis (packed-switch vs sparse-switch tables)
Finite-State Machine (FSM) dispatch recovery
Exception handling flow mapping (`.catch` / `.catchall` blocks)

stages.title: Stage 12 — Data Flow Analysis
stages.subtitle: Taint Analysis, Variable Propagation & Source-to-Sink Tracing

details.title: Taint & Data Tracking
items: Register & Variable value propagation tracing
Method parameters & Return value chain analysis
Bundle, Intent, & Parcelable payload tracking
JSON DTOs, Database Entities, & Network Response transformations
Source-to-Sink Taint Tracking for sensitive user/system data

stages.title: Stage 13 — Object Graph Reconstruction
stages.subtitle: Domain Model Recovery & Object Ownership

details.title: Object Structure Recovery
items: Class relationships, ownership, composition, and aggregation mapping
Singleton instance detection
Repositories, ViewModels, & Managers state recovery
Dependency Injection graph reconstruction (Hilt/Dagger component trees)

stages.title: Stage 14 — Lifecycle Analysis
stages.subtitle: Component Callbacks, Context Binding & Lifecycle Scopes

details.title: Lifecycle Call Chain Tracing
items: Tracing execution through component lifecycles:
• Application.onCreate() → Activity.onCreate() → Fragment.onViewCreated() → ViewModel → Repository → Data Source → UI Update
Mapping AndroidX LifecycleOwner events to business logic execution

stages.title: Stage 15 — Event Flow Analysis
stages.subtitle: User Interactions, System Events & Callback Handling

details.title: Event Handler Mapping
items: UI Touch and Click event listeners (`OnClickListener`, Compose gestures)
System Broadcasts & Custom Intent handling
Notification action callbacks & PendingIntent execution
Deep Link & App Link URL dispatch handlers
Background job triggers (WorkManager, JobScheduler)
WebView JavaScript bridge callbacks & Location/Sensor updates

stages.title: Stage 16 — Dependency Injection Analysis
stages.subtitle: Wiring Graph Extraction & Entry Point Identification

details.title: DI Graph Auditing
items: Identifying DI entry points (`@AndroidEntryPoint`, `@Inject`, `by inject()`)
Tracing injected object instances back to Provider modules
Differentiating DI infrastructure setup from application core domain code

stages.title: Stage 17 — Persistence Analysis
stages.subtitle: Database Schemas, Key-Value Stores & Encryption

details.title: Local Storage Auditing
items: Room Database schema parsing (`*Database_Impl` / DAO queries)
SharedPreferences & DataStore files analysis
EncryptedSharedPreferences & SQLCipher integration checks
File storage, Asset extraction, & Cache clearing policies

stages.title: Stage 18 — Networking Analysis
stages.subtitle: API Endpoints, Interceptors, Pinning & Traffic Inspection

details.title: Network Subsystem Auditing
items: Identifying HTTP clients (OkHttp, Retrofit, Cronet, Ktor)
Extracting hardcoded API Base URLs and endpoint contracts
Auditing Interceptor chains (Auth headers, logging, retries)
Analyzing Certificate Pinning & Custom TrustManager implementations
Inspecting Serialization models (Protobuf, Moshi, Gson)

stages.title: Stage 19 — Binder & IPC Analysis
stages.subtitle: Cross-Process Boundaries & Privileged Execution

details.title: IPC Boundary Tracing
items: Tracing Binder IPC calls: Framework API → Manager → Binder Proxy → System Service → HAL
Identifying privileged cross-process operation boundaries and permissions

stages.title: Stage 20 — Native Analysis
stages.subtitle: JNI Boundaries, Shared Objects & Native Interop

details.title: JNI & Native Code Inspection
items: Identifying JNI boundaries (`native` methods, `RegisterNatives`)
Parsing shared object (`.so`) exported and imported symbols
Auditing parameter marshaling and cross-language execution

stages.title: Stage 21 — Runtime Behavior Analysis
stages.subtitle: Dynamic Observation & Static Correlation

details.title: Dynamic Observation Targets
items: Monitoring process startup, thread creation, & memory allocation
Tracing Logcat output, Binder IPC traffic, & Network requests
Correlating dynamic runtime behavior with static DEX/Smali disassembly

stages.title: Stage 22 — Logging & Diagnostics
stages.subtitle: Telemetry, Crash Reporting & Feature Flags

details.title: Telemetry & Debugging Inspection
items: Identifying logging frameworks (Timber, Logcat wrappers)
Inspecting Crash Reporting (Crashlytics) & Analytics event tracking
Detecting Feature Flags, Remote Config, & Debug-only behaviors

stages.title: Stage 23 — Generated Code Identification
stages.subtitle: Isolating Framework Artifacts from Application Logic

details.title: CodeGen Isolation Checklist
items: Isolating Hilt/Dagger components (`*_Factory`, `*_MembersInjector`)
Isolating Room database implementations (`*Database_Impl`, `*Dao_Impl`)
Isolating Navigation Safe Args & ViewBinding/DataBinding classes
Isolating Compose compiler generated functions (`$composer`)
Focusing primary manual reverse engineering on handwritten business logic

stages.title: Stage 24 — Security Review
stages.subtitle: Vulnerability Assessment & Cryptographic Auditing

details.title: Security Assessment Checklist
items: Permissions usage & Exported component surface audit
Cryptographic API usage & Keystore hardware binding verification
Network Security Configuration & Cleartext traffic checks
Input validation, Secure storage, & Secret management audit

stages.title: Stage 25 — Obfuscation Recognition
stages.subtitle: R8, ProGuard, Reflection & Control Flow Flattening

details.title: Obfuscation Artifacts Recognition
items: Renamed identifiers (a/b/c package and method names)
Synthetic bridge methods, inlined calls, & merged classes
Control-flow flattening & String decryption routines
Reflection-heavy dynamic dispatch & dynamic DEX loading

stages.title: Stage 26 — Large Application Strategy
stages.subtitle: Scalable Triage Methodology for Complex APKs

details.title: Large APK Analysis Strategy
items: 1. Build technology and library profile
2. Reconstruct top-level architecture and package structure
3. Identify primary entry points (Activities, Services, Deep Links)
4. Isolate and strip generated infrastructure code from inventory
5. Build subsystem interaction diagrams
6. Trace one target feature end-to-end (UI -> Domain -> Data)
7. Expand scope incrementally (Avoid sequential reading of 10,000+ classes)

stages.title: Stage 27 — Documentation Workflow
stages.subtitle: Diagramming, Artifact Tracking & Investigation Mapping

details.title: Documentation Deliverables
items: Architecture diagrams & Package maps
Call graphs & Component interaction sequence diagrams
Data flow diagrams & Execution timeline notes

stages.title: Stage 28 — Automation Strategy
stages.subtitle: Scripting, Indexing & Report Generation

details.title: Automated Triage Targets
items: Manifest parsing, permission extraction, & exported component listing
DEX class inventory & third-party library identification
String reference extraction & API call cross-referencing
Automating repetitive triage tasks to focus manual analysis on core findings

stages.title: Stage 29 — Source Correlation
stages.subtitle: Cross-Abstraction Level Execution Mapping

details.title: Abstraction Level Correlation
items: Mapping execution across abstraction boundaries:
• Java / Kotlin Source → DEX Bytecode → Smali Assembly → ART Execution Engine → JNI Bridge → ARM64 Native Disassembly → Observed Runtime Behavior

stages.title: Stage 30 — Reporting
stages.subtitle: Executive Summaries, Evidence & Technical Deliverables

details.title: Professional Report Structure
items: Executive Summary & Key Findings
Architecture Overview & Technology Stack Profile
Application Surface & Component Analysis
Data Flow & Network/Persistence Security Observations
Native Components & Deep Dive Analysis
Evidence-supported conclusions & Appendices

stages.title: Stage 31 — Reading Open Source
stages.subtitle: Pattern Intuition Building via Open-Source Codebases

details.title: Codebase Comparison Strategy
items: Comparing open-source source code against compiled/decompiled APK output:
• Source Code → Compiled Binary → DEX/Smali → Decompiler Output → Dynamic Behavior
Building intuition for recognizing common design patterns and compiler transformations

stages.title: Stage 32 — Professional Investigation Checklist
stages.subtitle: End-to-End Analysis Checklist

details.title: Final Assessment Checklist
items: What architectural pattern is utilized?
Which third-party libraries and frameworks are embedded?
Which components form the external attack surface?
How does the application start and initialize state?
Where is core business logic located?
How is state managed across configuration changes and process death?
How does networking, serialization, and certificate validation operate?
How is data stored at rest and protected?
Which native shared libraries exist and what JNI methods are registered?
Which framework APIs and Binder IPC interfaces are heavily called?
Which code is generated vs handwritten?
How does application behavior evolve across its lifecycle?
